mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pk_user_setting(user_id, invisible, updated_at) VALUES(#{userId}, #{invisible}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE invisible = #{invisible}, updated_at = NOW()

INSERT INTO pk_user_setting( user_id, first_win_declaration, revenge_declaration, sweep_declaration, final_win_declaration, updated_at ) VALUES( #{userId}, #{firstWinDeclaration}, #{revengeDeclaration}, #{sweepDeclaration}, #{finalWinDeclaration}, NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE first_win_declaration = #{firstWinDeclaration}, revenge_declaration = #{revengeDeclaration}, sweep_declaration = #{sweepDeclaration}, final_win_declaration = #{finalWinDeclaration}, updated_at = NOW()
